title: Donavan Brazier Wins US 800m Title After 3 Years
excerpt: Donavan Brazier won the 2025 US 800m title in 1:42.16 after nearly three years away from racing. How to approach your own comeback.
body:
Donavan Brazier won the 800m at the 2025 USATF Outdoor Championships at Hayward Field in 1:42.16, completing his return after nearly three years away from racing. LetsRun reported that he had made slow but steady gains since starting work with his new coach in February 2025. Runner-up Cooper Lutkenhaus ran 1:42.27, an under-18 world record.

Brazier's comeback took months of gradual progress, not a sudden return to full training. The same applies to anyone coming back from injury or a long break: rushing back to your old training load is the most common way to end up injured again.

If you're returning from injury or time off, make about 80% of your previous peak your first milestone, not 100%. Reaching a smaller goal with confidence is more useful than falling short of an overambitious one.

Sources: LetsRun.com; USATF
keyTakeaway: When you return from a break, aim for about 80% of your previous peak as your first milestone.
